campi_del_mandato.environmental_conditions: Beds seasoned 1-3 months, near dry: residual saturation 0.05 assumed and declared
campi_del_mandato.instrument: Certified exhalation over 48 and 44 experiments respectively
campi_del_mandato.missing_values: Emanation has a declared band of a factor 2.8 across sources (0.15 / 0.20 / 0.42): the comparison is presented on the band.

sampling_frequency.motivo: certified mean over tens of experiments, not a time series

campi_del_mandato.site: Two phosphogypsum metrological reference beds, Universidad de Huelva (RB1 6.0 cm, 35 kg; RB2 13.0 cm, 73 kg)
campi_del_mandato.soil_properties: Ra-226 451+-7 (RB1) and 420+-8 (RB2) Bq/kg; densities 1080 and 1011 kg/m3; porosity derived from density with the grain density of the 2026 set
campi_del_mandato.split: BLOCKED TEST, for the same reason as Santander.
campi_del_mandato.units: Ra-226 Bq/kg; density kg/m3; thickness cm; flux mBq/m2/s

note: At the measured emanation 0.20 both certified fluxes sit ABOVE their own production ceiling (ratios 1.080 and 1.013), which inverts to emanation 0.2161 and 0.2026, inside the measured band 0.20+-0.04.
